title: Checkout mutation delivery needs replay and content preconditions
wanted_capability: Prevent stale full-file delivery or lost-ack replay from overwriting newer checkout content, and define the delivery boundary for paired mutations.
notes:
Daemon admission now composes outstanding edits and rejects conflicting accepted publications. Collector delivery still writes complete files and retries unacknowledged deliveries; transport preconditions and paired-file atomicity are separate remaining work.

Static follow-up traced operation-based replay and ACK durability gaps. Next bounded milestone: guarded write/delete preconditions using original source bytes or preceding queued postimages; durable per-checkout receipts bound to mutation identity and request hash; target plus receipt through existing checkout transactions; guarded recovery that refuses unexpected external content; validate ACK digest and repeat the persistence barrier for duplicate terminal ACKs. Paired-file atomicity needs separate batch identity/poll/settlement; existing transaction manifests are not a permanent replay ledger. Regression matrix: stale write/delete, lost ACK then local edit/recreation, crash/restart, conflicting IDs, chained preconditions, duplicate ACK after persistence failure.
